summary: Fixed two bugs in gym runner's copyEnvironment and syncNewFilesFromRoot functions. copyEnvironment now auto-detects when scenarios expect environment/ subdirectory structure (by checking criteria references). syncNewFilesFromRoot now handles directories, not just files. Root cause of optimizer's 0/7 on optimize-deploy-config identified: agent binary doesn't support --work-dir, so it operates at /app not in tmpdir.

decisions: copyEnvironment auto-detects directory preservation via criteria content analysis
syncNewFilesFromRoot extended to handle directories created by agent at PROJECT_ROOT
Root cause: agent binary ignores --work-dir flag, works at /app
next_steps: The --work-dir issue is the deeper blocker — agent creates files at /app not tmpdir
Need to either: (1) make the binary respect --work-dir, or (2) pre-stage environment at /app/environment/ before agent runs and clean up after
Option 2 is simpler but risks polluting /app for concurrent runs
Also: exit-code-misread has the same copyEnvironment bug (also references environment/ in criteria)
